name: Empty State
description: An explanatory empty result with an optional action and SVG icon.
usage:
<EmptyState
  title="No reports"
  description="Create a report to begin tracking results."
  action={<Button>Create report</Button>}
/>

anatomy.description: Rounded container holding a decorative SVG icon; hidden from assistive technology.
Heading naming the empty condition; renders h3 by default and adjusts with titleAs.
Short explanation of why the surface is empty and what happens next.
Caller-supplied next step, usually a single primary Button.

dos: Lead with what happened, then offer one clear next action.
Distinguish a first-run empty surface from a filtered no-results state in the copy.
donts: Don't use an empty state while content is still loading; use Skeleton or LoadingState.
Don't stack several competing actions under one empty state.

examples.title: First-run
examples.description: Pair a short explanation with a single primary action.

examples.title: Filtered empty result
examples.description: Explain that filters produced no results and offer a way to adjust them.

guidance.useWhen: A product surface has no results or has not been configured.
guidance.avoidWhen: Content is merely loading or filtered temporarily.
guidance.behavior: Explain what happened and give one clear next action when useful.
guidance.responsive: Keep the message readable and center the action beneath it.

notes: The title renders as an h3 by default; adjust titleAs so the empty state fits the page outline.
The action is a real button or link; keep to a single primary action.

props.description: Call to action rendered below the description.
props.name: action

props.description: Supporting text that explains the empty state.

props.description: Short heading for the empty state.
